Omit uncertain candidates or ask optional questions. Do not classify every word. Do not choose purpose, save, merge transactions, convert currency, or compute totals. Reply JSON {version:"phrase-candidates/0.6",documents:[{id,candidates:[{field,value,ref}],questions:[{field,reason,ref?}]}]}. All values are strings. Questions are optional; reason is missing, conflict, or uncertain.
